description: Agent Feedback: submit the receiver’s response and revision record for one round of feedback on a specific piece of work: optionally the reply to the giver with its text and when it was sent, read for acknowledgement-only wording such as thanks, noted; the revised version with when it was made; and each feedback item with its id, the point as given, whether it was acknowledged to the giver, what the receiver did (changed the work, declined, deferred or nothing), the reason for a decline or deferral, the date a deferred item will be taken up, the change the reply claims for it and whether the revised work holds that change. The signed report gives every item as incorporated, declined_with_reason, deferred_with_date, answered_with_reason, noted_only, claimed_absent, unacknowledged, declined_unreasoned, deferred_undated or unconfirmed, counts the acknowledged, changed, declined and deferred items and the changes present in the revision, and names feedback that did not land: items never acknowledged at all, thanks, noted with no change and no reason, and changes the reply claims that the revised work does not hold; then declines with no reason and deferrals with no date, with the fix for each. This reads one round of response to feedback, not a standing record: an agent’s durable record of completed jobs is wever_reputation-record-check, and a collision between agents’ recorded decisions on shared work is wever_coordination-conflict-check. Verdict feedback_not_landed, feedback_incorporation_gaps, feedback_incorporation_unverified or feedback_incorporated. POST /api/feedback-incorporation-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.

items.description: Each feedback item with the receiver’s response.

acknowledged.description: The receiver acknowledged this item to the giver.

claimed_change.description: The change the reply says was made for this item.

defer_until.description: When a deferred item will be taken up.

id.description: The feedback item id, such as f1.

in_revision.description: The revised work holds the change.

reason.description: The reason given for declining or deferring.

response.description: What the receiver did: changed the work, declined, deferred, or nothing.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

text.description: The receiver’s reply to the giver, read for acknowledgement-only wording such as thanks, noted.

version.description: The revised version of the work.

name: wever_feedback-incorporation-check
title: Feedback incorporation check
